about.text:
Modern life makes it hard to be healthy. 

Without knowing it, by the time we reach our 40s and 50s, many of us will have dramatically increased our chances of becoming ill later in life. The good news is we can fight back. 

One You is here to help you get back to a healthier you - providing tools, ideas and encouragement to make the simple changes that can add up to a longer and happier life. 

Because there is only One You
